title: AI Water Detection System
description: Smart AI powered system for water quality detection, contamination monitoring and real-time safety alerts.
longDescription: This project provides a smart real-time sensor network connected to AI predictive models to identify biological and chemical contaminants in water sources. Designed for rural communities, industrial discharge monitoring, and municipal water treatment plants.

title: Smart Farming Irrigation
description: IoT based irrigation monitoring with automatic moisture sensing and soil analysis.
longDescription: Automated precision agriculture platform utilizing subterranean moisture sensors, local weather forecasting telemetry, and smart micro-valves to reduce agricultural water waste by 40%.

highlights.title: Automated Valves
highlights.desc: Smart flow control with zero manual effort

title: Autonomous Rescue Robot
description: Robotic navigation unit designed for hazardous environments, disaster relief, and survivor localization.
longDescription: A ruggedized, tracked autonomous ground vehicle equipped with thermal imaging, LIDAR mapping, and CO2 detectors to locate victims trapped in collapsed structures or hazardous chemical environments without endangering first responders.

highlights.title: Thermal Sensing
highlights.desc: FLIR thermal vision for human signature detection

title: Smart Campus Energy Grid
description: Intelligent solar grid optimizer that balances peak power load dynamically across academic buildings.
longDescription: High-efficiency microgrid controller that predicts solar insolation and shifts high-draw HVAC and laboratory equipment power across renewable battery banks.

highlights.title: Peak Load Shaving
highlights.desc: Reduces peak electricity tariff costs by 32%
